newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Ceremonies marking seven years since the bloody Romanian revolution which toppled former dictator Nicolae Ceausescu include a day of mourning in the western city of Timisoara to honour the numerous deaths on December 17, 1989.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will meet a delegation of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development as part of broad discussions on a programme of the newly-appointed centrist cabinet.
* The Chamber of Deputies started debate on a road traffic bill which is expected to settle the question of pollution by outdated Romanian-made trucks and lorries.
* Hungarian Democratic Union deputies asked MPs to consider calling a extraodinary session of parliament in January to discuss vital laws.
* Romania and its Black Sea Economic Cooperation partners signed an agreement to fight organised crime and exchange legal information.
* Reform Minister Ulm Spineanu called a news conference on his plans for swift privatisation.
* Some 80 percent of Bucharest postal workers went on strike on Tuesday to protest against bad managerial decisions and cuts in Christmas bonuses.

* Romanian and Ukraine border authorities held a session to reopen border cross at Halmeu, in northern Romania, for passenger traffic. The Halmeu customs point could open on December 20. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
